reconstruction.scope: Specific standing western/northwestern Golestan dakhma at Yazd: separately mapped irregular broad ring with taller surviving roofless masonry and worn ocher plaster, genuinely open low eastern arched passage, projecting rectangular entrance landing and supported approach steps, gritty open court and smaller irregular recessed pit/broken lip/loose rubble. Four reused shared rubble/raw sandstone/stucco/gravel graphs. No intact historical tall tower, roof, bodies/bones, copied label/photo atlas, lower precinct buildings, eastern dakhma, complete hill or broad terrain slab.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Keep the original6m standard Mapzen hill, native roads/water and every independent building including the eastern dakhma and lower precinct. Replace only the western native circle. Court/pit floor stays above occupied coarse native terrain; pit is truly recessed without a ground cutout. Bounded battered raw-stone contact within the mapped outline supports the court; buried feet and the narrow steps/projecting entry landing contact coarse grade. Rocky seat and foundation dimensions are visualization estimates, not surveyed hill/excavation engineering. No whole-hill mesh, broad slab, ground/water cutout or valley flattening.
